fast.change: Added a typer version flag option with an eager callback to the main_callback function.
fast.impact: Enables the --version/-v CLI flag to display version information and terminate execution immediately.

detailed.change: The function signature now explicitly includes a version parameter configured via typer.Option. It defines the flag aliases, sets is_eager to True to ensure immediate execution, and links a version_callback to handle the logic flow when the flag is triggered.
detailed.impact: This introduces a standard CLI behavior where version querying short-circuits the main application logic. By utilizing is_eager, the application will exit before any subsequent processing occurs, preventing unnecessary initialization overhead when a user only requests the version string.
detailed.risk: The implementation follows standard CLI patterns and isolates the behavior within a callback, minimizing potential interference with core functionality. The risk is negligible as it merely adds a non-breaking helper flag. low
